# Result & Restart Requirements Checklist: Result Restart Validation

**Purpose**: Validate requirement quality for round-end, result display, restart reset, and permission boundaries (unit tests for English — not implementation verification).

**Created**: 2026-05-29

**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md) | [plan.md](../plan.md) | [contracts/rooms-api.md](../contracts/rooms-api.md)

**Note**: Generated by `/speckit-checklist`. Use alongside [requirements.md](./requirements.md) for generic spec quality.

**Defaults applied** (no user scope input): Standard depth, PR/reviewer audience, focus on lifecycle + sync + permissions.

---

## Requirement Completeness

- [ ] CHK001 Are requirements defined for how a round transitions from active play to result state (trigger, actor, valid source phase)? [Gap, Spec §FR-001]
- [ ] CHK002 Is the `result` room phase named and distinguished from `lobby` and `playing` in requirements? [Completeness, Spec §FR-001]
- [ ] CHK003 Are all three result payload elements (revealed word, final scores, guess history) explicitly required for every viewer? [Completeness, Spec §FR-002–FR-004]
- [ ] CHK004 Are requirements defined for which round-scoped fields must be cleared on restart (word, drawing, guesses, scores, drawer/round roles)? [Completeness, Spec §FR-010]
- [ ] CHK005 Are requirements defined for which participant attributes must survive restart (identity, roster membership, host designation)? [Completeness, Spec §FR-009]
- [ ] CHK006 Are host-only permissions specified for both ending a round and restarting after results? [Gap, Spec §FR-005 vs §FR-001]
- [ ] CHK007 Are rejection rules documented for restart attempts outside `result` and by non-host actors? [Completeness, Spec §FR-006–FR-007, US3]
- [ ] CHK008 Is an explicit out-of-scope list documented (multi-round rotation, timers, auto-end, spectators)? [Gap, Plan constraints; Spec Assumptions]

---

## Requirement Clarity

- [ ] CHK009 Is “round completion” defined with an unambiguous trigger (e.g., host action vs auto-end on correct guess)? [Clarity, Gap — Spec §FR-001]
- [ ] CHK010 Is “correct word” defined as the round’s secret word revealed post-round (not guess text)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-002, US1]
- [ ] CHK011 Is “full ordered guess history” defined (ordering rule, inclusion of correct/incorrect, empty round behavior)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-004, Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK012 Is “final scoreboard” defined as immutable snapshot values at round end (not live-updating)? [Clarity, Spec Assumptions, §FR-003]
- [ ] CHK013 Is “players preserved” defined with concrete identity fields (e.g., participant id and display name)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-009, Key Entities]
- [ ] CHK014 Is “all round state cleared” enumerated so lobby-visible state cannot leak word/scores/history/canvas? [Clarity, Spec §FR-010–FR-011]
- [ ] CHK015 Are error/denial outcomes for invalid phase or role described in requirements (not only “rejected”)? [Clarity, Gap, US3]

---

## Requirement Consistency

- [ ] CHK016 Do secret-word visibility rules during `playing` vs `result` align without contradiction (drawer-only vs all players)? [Consistency, Spec §FR-002 + Scenario 3 assumptions]
- [ ] CHK017 Are restart clearing rules consistent with “no stale round data in lobby” (FR-011) and roster preservation (FR-009)? [Consistency, Spec §FR-009–FR-011]
- [ ] CHK018 Do user-story acceptance scenarios align with functional requirements FR-001–FR-011 (no orphan behaviors)? [Consistency, Spec User Stories vs Requirements]
- [ ] CHK019 Are success criteria SC-001–SC-004 consistent with acceptance scenarios (same actors, same artifacts)? [Consistency, Success Criteria vs US1–US3]
- [ ] CHK020 If plan/contract omit canvas on result snapshots, is that exclusion consistent with spec user-visible result requirements? [Consistency, Gap — contract vs Spec §FR-002–FR-004]

---

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [ ] CHK021 Can SC-001 (“100% matching word, scores, history”) be verified without implementation details? [Measurability, Spec §SC-001]
- [ ] CHK022 Is SC-002’s “within 3 seconds” tied to a defined user-visible outcome (lobby transition) rather than internal timing? [Measurability, Spec §SC-002]
- [ ] CHK023 Does SC-003 cover both non-host and invalid-phase denial with a measurable “no state change” criterion? [Measurability, Spec §SC-003]
- [ ] CHK024 Does SC-004 separately test roster preservation and absence of round fields in lobby-visible state? [Measurability, Spec §SC-004]
- [ ] CHK025 Does each P1 user story include an independent test statement that can run without later stories? [Acceptance Criteria Quality, US1–US2]

---

## Scenario Coverage

- [ ] CHK026 Are primary flows documented: play → result review → host restart → lobby? [Coverage, US1–US2]
- [ ] CHK027 Are alternate flows addressed (reconnect during result, late joiner viewing result via poll)? [Coverage, Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK028 Are exception flows defined for unauthorized end-round/restart and gameplay mutations during `result`? [Coverage, US3, Gap]
- [ ] CHK029 Are recovery flows defined after partial client desync (poll catches `result` or `lobby` transition)? [Coverage, Gap]
- [ ] CHK030 Is post-restart “start new round” behavior specified without implying automatic round start? [Coverage, Spec Assumptions]

---

## Edge Case Coverage

- [ ] CHK031 Are zero-guess rounds explicitly required to show empty history (not omitted UI)? [Edge Case, Spec Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK032 Are duplicate rapid restart (or end-round) requests addressed in requirements (idempotency or second-call rejection)? [Edge Case, Spec Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK033 Are disconnect-during-restart requirements defined for remaining players and reconnecting player stale-state avoidance? [Edge Case, Spec Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK034 Is behavior specified when host disconnects before restart while room remains in `result`? [Gap, Exception Flow]
- [ ] CHK035 Are concurrent end-round and in-flight guess/canvas mutations addressed (freeze vs reject)? [Gap, Spec Assumptions “finalized at round end”]

---

## Non-Functional Requirements

- [ ] CHK036 Are multi-client consistency expectations for result view quantified (e.g., sync window)? [Non-Functional, Spec §SC-001, Gap]
- [ ] CHK037 Are performance expectations for restart visibility stated in user-observable terms? [Non-Functional, Spec §SC-002]
- [ ] CHK038 Are multi-room isolation requirements referenced or inherited for result/restart state? [Non-Functional, Gap — constitution cross-ref]
- [ ] CHK039 Are security/privacy requirements for secret-word revelation timing explicit (only after round end for guessers)? [Non-Functional, Spec §FR-002]

---

## Dependencies & Assumptions

- [ ] CHK040 Is dependency on a single designated host documented with failure behavior if host unavailable? [Assumption, Spec Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK041 Is dependency on Scenarios 1–3 (lobby, playing gameplay, scoring rules) explicit for this feature? [Dependency, Tasks prerequisites]
- [ ] CHK042 Is the assumption “scores/history immutable during result display” testable and bounded? [Assumption, Spec Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK043 Is rejoin behavior for disconnected players during/after result scoped (in vs out of validation)? [Assumption, Spec Assumptions]

## Ambiguities & Conflicts

- [ ] CHK044 Is the round-end trigger documented in the spec (not only plan/research), or flagged as a spec gap to close? [Ambiguity, Gap — FR-001 vs research R1]
- [ ] CHK045 Does terminology consistently use “restart” vs “reset” vs “return to lobby” for the same transition? [Terminology, Spec US2, FR-008]
- [ ] CHK046 Are “connected players” vs “all players” scopes consistent across FR-008, SC-001, and edge-case reconnect bullets? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-008, §SC-001]
- [ ] CHK047 Is there conflict between allowing future round start after restart and out-of-scope multi-round rotation? [Conflict check, Spec Assumptions vs README scope]
